title: About React
description: This blog is about the importance of learning and understanding the world around us. It is a place to share knowledge and ideas, and to inspire others to do the same.
content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It is maintained by Facebook and a community of individual developers and companies. React can be used as a base in the development of single-page or mobile applications.
author: Salomon Elisha

title: About JavaScript
description: This blog is about the importance of learning and understanding the world around us. It is a place to share knowledge and ideas, and to inspire others to do the same.
content: JavaScript is a programming language that is one of the core technologies of the World Wide Web. JavaScript enables interactive web pages and is an essential part of web applications.
author: Salomon Elisha

title: About CSS
description: This blog is about the importance of learning and understanding the world around us. It is a place to share knowledge and ideas, and to inspire others to do the same.
content: CSS is a style sheet language used for describing the presentation of a document written in a markup language like HTML. CSS is a cornerstone technology of the World Wide Web, alongside HTML and JavaScript.
author: Salomon Elisha

title: About HTML
description: This blog is about the importance of learning and understanding the world around us. It is a place to share knowledge and ideas, and to inspire others to do the same.
content: HTML is the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser. It defines the meaning and structure of web content.
author: Salomon Elisha

title: About TypeScript
description: This blog is about the importance of learning and understanding the world around us. It is a place to share knowledge and ideas, and to inspire others to do the same.
content: TypeScript is a programming language developed and maintained by Microsoft. It is a strict syntactical superset of JavaScript and adds optional static typing to the language.
author: Salomon Elisha
